title: instrument-token-lifecycle-mapper-and-sampled-token-trace-sampler
author: Ethan Park
merge_outcome: Merged after addressing flaky test and adding runbook link
description: Motivation: We recently saw an incident (SUP-3893) where tenant token cost spikes correlated with kernel queueing but were hard to attribute to specific invocation phases. This PR introduces a lightweight Token Lifecycle Mapper and an associated sampled token trace sampler to bridge token-level cost/latency breakdowns with kernel and queue metrics. Goals: 1) make per-token phase attribution available in rollups (warmup, generation, post-processing); 2) surface compact sampled traces that include kernel queue/occupancy tags so SRE can triage long-tail latency/cost spikes; 3) add a dashboard and alert attenuation rules to reduce noise from transient kernel contention. Changes in this PR: - Add a Token Lifecycle Mapper that emits phase tags at the invocation boundary and synthesizes phase-duration metrics for rollups. Mapper is implemented as an opt-in middleware so it can be enabled per-route. - Implement a Sampled Token Trace Sampler that attaches a compact span bundle to sampled invocations. The sampler uses adaptive reservoir sampling weighted by estimated token-cost to bias captures toward expensive invocations. - Dashboard: new Observability > Token Lifecycle Explorer with: phase duration histogram, kernel-queue correlation scatter, sampled trace quick-links, and per-tenant cost-attribution sparkline. - Alerts: introduce an alert attenuator that smooths alerting for kernel-backed latency spikes by requiring sustained cross-stage increases for 3 minutes before firing. - Tests: unit + integration tests for mapper and sampler; added an e2e smoke that validates sampled trace enrichment and dashboard ingestion path. - Docs/runbook: added an entry describing how to interpret the lifecycle explorer and triage flow for token-cost spikes. Checklist: - [x] Design review (Ava) - [x] Security review for PII/redaction (Claire) - [x] Performance benching in benchmark-lab (Miguel) - [x] Added runbook link and alert playbook - [x] CI green after flake fix How to enable: set route config "token_lifecycle.enabled=true" and optional "token_lifecycle.sampling_weight_threshold". Backwards compatibility: disabled by default; no change to public API contract. Follow-ups: - Telemetry retention tuning for phase metrics (ENG-2711) - Consider exposing phase-level cost attribution in the billing export pipeline (product discussion).
